_comment: Reconstruction of EricaNext simulated raw data (RawWriter2p, config/simulation/smile2p_flight_parma_thermal_neutron_d10_raw.json)
with the settings of the SMILE_tool_box reconstruction of the reference simulation
Set the raw directory with --set ReadData.data_dir=<raw dir>.
{sim_data}/emulator_param: MDF for the emulator, Cal_HA*.dat of HAEmulator, HAs.pos, drift velocity of the simulation (README.txt there).

HA_Calc._HabocStatus: Emu_Mode 1, Parameter_Data_Dir parameters/emulator, Flag_Modify_PMT_Gain 0, SingleHit_Eth 50, SingleHit_ADCth 1000

TOT_Skewness._note: the drift-velocity file of the reference reconstruction (hikaru3_analysis2/par_for_sim_reconstruct): offset 85, 0.38 mm/clock; drift_velocity_sim.dat is the one derived from the simulated hit clocks (offset 93, 0.3770)
